{{Quote|Hello there. I'm Hal Horn. I retired from CorSec a while back, but my son, Corran, is following in the family career. I'm helping him stop the recent traffic in survapierre, an Old Republic medicine with illegal recreational uses. I'd like you to pick up some correspondence from a slythmonger that may lead us to the supplier.|Hal Horn, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Survapierre''' was a recreational and illegal [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. With the right licenses, however, it could be used for medicinal purposes.
